info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Mutual Fund Administration API
info.description: The Mutual Fund Administration API facilitates the management of mutual fund operations within a banking ecosystem. This API allows users to efficiently process transactions related to mutual fund investments, including subscription and redemption requests. Targeted primarily at financial institutions and investment managers, it streamlines the administration of mutual fund accounts, ensuring compliance and enhancing customer service. Key use cases include portfolio management, customer account handling, and transaction processing for mutual funds.
